title: Identical harvest publication returns NOOP_CURRENT
summary: Repeat publication with the same payloadHash must not republish L:, Z:, or Supabase. Pointer-only Git commits must not change payload identity or trigger republication.
retrievalQuestions: When should an existing harvest seed return NOOP_CURRENT instead of republishing?
How does NOOP_CURRENT prevent a freshness treadmill?
